questions.q: Who gathered together before Yahweh at Mizpah?
questions.a: All the people from Dan to Beersheba, including the land of Gilead, gathered together before Yahweh at Mizpah.

questions.q: What did the Levite say the men of Gibeah did to him?
questions.a: The Levite said the men of Gibeah surrounded the house in order to abuse and kill him.

questions.q: Why did the tribes of Israel tell Benjamin to give them those wicked men of Gibeah?
questions.a: The tribes of Israel told Benjamin to give them those wicked men of Gibeah, so they might put them to death in order to completely remove this evil from Israel.

questions.q: Why did the people of Benjamin come together at Gibeah?
questions.a: The people of Benjamin came together at Gibeah to defend it against the people of Israel.

questions.q: What was special about the 700 chosen men?
questions.a: The 700 chosen men were left-handed; each of them could sling a stone with great accuracy.
The people asked God and he told them that Judah should attack first.

questions.q: After Benjamin killed many soldiers of Israel, what did the soldiers of Israel do?
questions.a: After Benjamin killed many soldiers of Israel, the soldiers of Israel wept and fasted before Yahweh until evening. They also offered burnt offerings and peace offerings to Yahweh.

questions.q: Where was the Box of the Covenant of God in those days?
questions.a: The Box of the Covenant of God was in Bethel at that time.

questions.q: When the soldiers of Israel drew away from the city, what did the people of Benjamin think?
questions.a: When the soldiers of Israel drew away from the city, the people of Benjamin thought they had defeated them and they were running away.

questions.q: Why had the men of Israel retreated?
questions.a: The men of Israel had retreated because they wanted the Benjaminites to be drawn out of the city where they had men hidden outside Gibeah waiting to attack them.

questions.q: What was the signal between the soldiers of Israel and the men hiding in secret?
questions.a: The arranged signal between the soldiers of Israel and the men hiding in secret was that a great cloud of smoke would rise up out of the city.

questions.q: Why could the men of Benjamin not escape?
questions.a: The men of Benjamin ran away from the soldiers of Israel, trying to escape into the wilderness, but they were caught between the two groups of Israelites.

questions.q: How many soldiers of Benjamin turned and fled to the wilderness?
questions.a: Six hundred men were able to escape to the wilderness.

commentary.text: The tribe of Benjamin nearly extirpated.

—The Israelites' abhorrence of the crime committed at Gibeah, and their resolution to punish the criminals, were right; but they formed their resolves with too much haste and self-confidence. The eternal ruin of souls will be worse, and more fearful, than these desolations of a tribe.
